_comment: The worth-it inputs behind the 31 Oct refusal (decision-2026-10-31-questing.md), so the verdict is reproducible:
npm run worth-it -- --file galxe-desk/docs/decision-2026-10-31.json   (judges the realistic case at the top level)
The generous case is complete on its own under `generous`. Both are pinned by galxe-desk/scripts/decision.test.mjs.
Figures are Leif's own (account.json): a $15/h bar and 30 minutes a week, so 90 days of weekly passes is about 6.5 h.
Break-even at that bar is about $1,025 realised at 20% odds, or $205 at certainty; documented prizes run about $10.
name: Galxe questing as income, the realistic case (31 Oct 2026)
cheapestTest: Does one drop to Joyisfree's existing list outperform a plain email to the same list? It needs no Space, no deposit, no wallet and no new platform.

killRule.metric: realised dollars by day 30 of a 90-day run from the decision date
